themes.evidence: We are here for one purpose, to help build a better world, where every person is free to move and pursue their dreams.
The culture is anchored in shared beliefs and ideals, acting for the common good.
As an organization, Ford believes everyone should have the freedom to move and pursue their dreams, and seeks to create a culture of belonging for every employee.

Henry Ford transformed not only the automobile but working life and the role of transportation. Having played our part in everything from the birth of the middle class to the recent global pandemic, we serve the world with integrity and competence.

linguistic_shift: The page emphasizes the company's purpose and values more than in prior years, with a stronger focus on the common good and belonging.
